_comment: Agent SOP update config. Default location: ~/.claude/agent-sop.config.json. Per-project override: .claude/agent-sop.config.json (takes precedence if present). Auto-created by setup.sh at install; /update-agent-sop writes here each sync.
_local_path_note: Path to a local agent-sop checkout. Used first. If missing or invalid, /update-agent-sop falls back to GitHub raw.
_github_note: GitHub repo (OWNER/REPO). Used when local_path is unavailable. Fetches from raw.githubusercontent.com/{github}/main/{file}.
_update_reminder_values: weekly | manual | off. /restart-sop prints a one-line staleness warning when last_update_check is older than this cadence.
_last_update_check_note: ISO date string or null. Updated by /update-agent-sop on each run.
_multi_agent_values: auto | on | off. auto detects parallel mode from git worktree count. on forces parallel conventions (per-agent directories, per-agent resume files) regardless of worktree count. off forces single-agent conventions with literal 'solo' id. See docs/guides/multi-agent-parallel-sessions.md.
_agent_id_override_note: String or null. Takes precedence over CLAUDE_AGENT_ID env var and .sop-agent-id file. Rarely used — prefer env var or per-worktree file for identity.
_review_threshold_note: P44 reviewer-turn gate. When a [Feature] or [Refactor] ships AND the session diff exceeds either threshold, /update-sop Step 2 (review) invokes code-reviewer (or security-reviewer for auth/crypto/payment diffs) and requires a substantive review artifact at docs/reviews/. Set review_loc_threshold to 0 for always-on-code mode (every Feature/Refactor with non-skipped paths fires the gate regardless of size). Set both to a very large number to effectively disable the gate.
_review_triggers_note: P59 project-declared reviewer triggers. Array of path globs (relative to repo root) that force Step 2 (review) to fire on any session touching them, regardless of LOC. Use for project-specific load-bearing paths — e.g. ['server/prisma/schema.prisma', 'server/prisma/migrations/**', 'server/src/middleware/auth.js']. Triggers are additive to the LOC threshold and the SOP-self-modification trigger; any one match fires the gate.
_exclude_note: Array of pristine-replica paths (relative to project root) to skip during /update-agent-sop sync. Excluded files are reported as EXCLUDED, never classified, never synced, and have no baseline tracked. Use this when the project deliberately runs a local override of a file with the same path as an upstream pristine — e.g. ['docs/sop/security.md'] for a project that ships its own project-specific security doc rather than agent-sop's generic one. Replaces the older workaround of freezing a baseline SHA and adding an explanatory note.

baseline_shas._comment: SHA-256 of each pristine-replica file at last sync. Used for three-way diff (baseline vs local vs upstream) to detect local modifications. Populated by setup.sh at install and updated by /update-agent-sop per file.
